title: 500k facial scans at UK stations yield no arrests, 1 false positive
summary: A UK trial deploying live facial recognition cameras at London stations scanned 500,000 faces, resulting in zero arrests and one false positive. The Guardian reports the outcome, sparking 296 Hacker News comments debating accuracy, privacy, and policing ethics. The result highlights ongoing concerns about the real-world effectiveness and civil liberties implications of biometric surveillance systems.
